d:
Bihar ki dharti men hamesha hi 'hire' janm lie hain. bihar se nikle man bharti ke vir saputon ne hamesha desh ki laj rakhi hai, aur usi bihar ki dharti shekhpura ki ek beti ne desh ke sainikon ke samman ke lie anokhi pahal ki hai. khushbu ab desh ke sainikon ke samman ke lie shekhpura se leh laddakh ke kargil vor memoriyal tak daur lagayegi.
